user.title: Add person
user.description: Whose music should follow them inside? You can add more people later, each with their own Spotify account.

speakers.title: Speakers
speakers.description: Pick the speakers. The first one is the group leader; the others are joined to it. 'Spotify Connect device' is the name Spotify shows for the leader (empty = name of the first speaker).

data.sonos_fallback: Fallback: let Sonos play the track itself when Spotify Connect doesn't see the speaker

data.only_alone: Only when nobody else is home
data.pause_margin: Also when Spotify was paused recently (minutes)
data.bt_timeout: Max wait for the car to switch off (minutes)

data_description.bt_sensor: With this sensor the integration waits until you switch off the car, so music keeps playing in the car until you get out.
data_description.car_name: Part of the name is enough, e.g. 'Skoda' or the MAC address.

error.car_name_required: Enter the car name when you choose a Bluetooth sensor.

abort.already_configured: This person is already set up.
